name: command_timeout
description: Local shell command exceeded its wall-clock budget (execute_command 200s cap) or a timed-out remote call surfaced TimeoutError locally.

name: ssh_unreachable
description: ssh_run could not establish a session to the target host (exit 255 even after mux auto-clear + retry) — host offline or sshd down.

name: kb_backend_timeout
description: KB search or engine health probe stalled on the backend (Elasticsearch/llama.cpp connection timeout, connection-pool exhaustion).

name: ssh_remote_timeout
description: Remote script or remote python one-liner timed out on the other node (FAIL: TimeoutError inside ssh_script, remote traceback in ssh_run stderr).

name: web_fetch_error
description: fetch_url failed with an HTTP client error — 403 Forbidden (bot-blocking) or 404 Not Found (dead URL).

name: file_not_found
description: read_file targeted a path that does not exist (stale path from memory, deleted artifact, or wrong working directory).

name: python_runtime_error
description: Python runtime exceptions in local commands: UnicodeDecodeError on binary output, missing module, or asyncio CancelledError.

name: credential_missing
description: Tool refused to run because a required credential was not provided (vault secret not unlocked/passed as api_key).

name: permission_denied
description: Guard blocked the call: privileged command in chained/complex shell text, write outside allowed paths, or permanently forbidden command.
patterns: detected in a chained or complex command
